syllabus.details: Physics: Mechanics, heat and thermodynamics, waves and sound, optics, electricity and magnetism, electronics, modern physics, radiation and nuclear physics, applied physics in forensics, experimental physics and instrumentation. Chemistry: Physical, organic, inorganic and analytical chemistry, forensic and applied chemistry, biochemistry, environmental chemistry, instrumentation. Biology: Cell biology, genetics, molecular biology and biotechnology, human anatomy and physiology, blood and serology, microbiology, immunology, biochemistry, forensic biology, ecology and environment. Mathematics: Arithmetic, algebra, geometry and mensuration, trigonometry, statistics, analytical and logical reasoning, advanced topics including permutation-combination and basic calculus. Forensic Science: General forensic science, crime scene investigation, physical and biological evidence, forensic biology and toxicology, forensic chemistry, questioned documents, ballistics and physics, cyber and digital forensics. | Part-2 covers computer and information technology fundamentals, internet/WWW, hardware-software, email, MS-Word and MS-Excel essentials, digital financial tools, cyber security, and emerging technologies such as Artificial Intelligence, Big Data, Deep Learning, Machine Learning, and the Internet of Things. Part-3 covers Uttar Pradesh's history, culture, art, festivals, geography, natural resources, economy, agriculture, industry, polity, and current affairs related to the state.

how_to_apply: Visit the official UPSSSC website: upsssc.gov.in
Go to the Live Advertisement Segment on the homepage and click on the relevant advertisement to download/view it.
Log in using your PET-2025 Registration Number and verify via the OTP sent to your registered mobile number/email.
Review your auto-displayed personal details (name, parentage, category, EWS/horizontal reservation status, date of birth, gender, marital status, contact details) carried forward from PET-2025.
Select (tick) the post(s) you wish to apply for from the displayed list of advertised posts; unselected posts will not be considered for your candidature.
Confirm your educational qualification for the selected post(s) by choosing Yes/No, and enter board/university, year of passing, certificate/roll number, and marks details.
Enter the verification code shown on the registration page and click Submit to generate your application form; download and save a copy.
Review your PET-2025 photograph and signature, which will be auto-displayed, then click Continue.
Indicate post preference (if multiple posts selected) and Yes/No for preferential qualification, then confirm your correspondence address.
Read the declaration carefully, tick all checkboxes to agree, enter the verification code, and click Save and Submit.
Pay the required fee online via Credit Card/Debit Card/Internet Banking/UPI or SBI e-Challan; on successful payment, the application is auto-submitted.
Download and print the final submitted application form for your records.

content_sections.heading: UPSSSC Forensic Science Laboratory Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Candidates must hold the essential educational qualification prescribed under the Uttar Pradesh Vidhi Vigyan Prayogshala Araajpatrit (Praviधik) Seva Niyamavali, 2016, and must have appeared in PET-2025 with a valid, non-zero and non-negative score in at least one domain. Candidates must hold a qualification in one of the following four domains: Biology Domain: B.Sc. in Biological Science / Forensic Science with specialization in Biological Science, Biotechnology, Bio Chemistry, Genetics, Cell Biology, or Microbiology from a recognized university/institute. Physical Science Domain: B.Sc. in Physical Science / Forensic Science with specialization in Physical Science, Nuclear Science, Instrumentation, or Electronics; OR B.Tech in Instrumentation/Electrical & Electronics Engineering/Civil and Mechanical Engineering. Chemistry Domain: B.Sc. in Chemistry / Forensic Science with specialization in Chemistry or Bio Chemistry from a recognized university/institute. Computer Science Domain: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, or an 'A' level diploma from NIELIT. Preferential Qualification: Candidates with an M.Sc. in the relevant subject (for Biology/Physical Science/Chemistry domains), a higher qualification in Computer Science, a minimum of two years' service in the Territorial Army, or a National Cadet Corps 'B' Certificate will be given preference in case of a tie in other respects. Biology Domain: B.Sc. in Biology Group/Biotechnology/Bio Chemistry/Genetics/Cell Biology/Microbiology from a recognized university/institute. Physical Science Domain: B.Sc. in Physical Science Group/Nuclear Science/Instrumentation/Electronics; OR B.Tech in Instrumentation/Electrical & Electronics. Chemistry Domain: B.Sc. in Chemistry Group/Bio Chemistry from a recognized university/institute. Computer Science Domain: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, or an 'A' level diploma from NIELIT. Preferential Qualification: Candidates with a minimum of two years' service in the Territorial Army, or a National Cadet Corps 'B' Certificate, will be given preference under the same rules. For both Scientific Assistant and Lab Assistant posts, candidates must have attained 21 years of age and must not have attained more than 40 years of age as on 1 July of the calendar year in which vacancies are advertised. Upper age relaxation is admissible for SC, ST, OBC candidates and other eligible categories as per Uttar Pradesh government rules notified from time to time.

content_sections.heading: UPSSSC Forensic Science Laboratory Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection is made purely on the basis of the Main (written) Examination. Shortlisting of candidates for the Main Examination is done using the normalized PET-2025 score, category-wise, at 15 times the number of advertised vacancies (including all candidates scoring at or above the final normalized cut-off up to two decimal places). Candidates with a zero or negative actual/normalized PET-2025 score will not be shortlisted. The written examination will consist of a single question paper of 100 objective-type, multiple-choice questions carrying 100 marks, to be completed in 2 hours (120 minutes). Each question carries 1 mark, and there is a negative marking of 25% (1/4 mark) for each wrong answer. Time allowed for the complete examination is 2 hours (120 minutes). Physics: Mechanics, heat and thermodynamics, waves and sound, optics, electricity and magnetism, electronics, modern physics, radiation and nuclear physics, applied physics in forensics, experimental physics and instrumentation. Chemistry: Physical, organic, inorganic and analytical chemistry, forensic and applied chemistry, biochemistry, environmental chemistry, instrumentation. Biology: Cell biology, genetics, molecular biology and biotechnology, human anatomy and physiology, blood and serology, microbiology, immunology, biochemistry, forensic biology, ecology and environment. Mathematics: Arithmetic, algebra, geometry and mensuration, trigonometry, statistics, analytical and logical reasoning, advanced topics including permutation-combination and basic calculus. Forensic Science: General forensic science, crime scene investigation, physical and biological evidence, forensic biology and toxicology, forensic chemistry, questioned documents, ballistics and physics, cyber and digital forensics. Part-2 covers computer and information technology fundamentals, internet/WWW, hardware-software, email, MS-Word and MS-Excel essentials, digital financial tools, cyber security, and emerging technologies such as Artificial Intelligence, Big Data, Deep Learning, Machine Learning, and the Internet of Things. Part-3 covers Uttar Pradesh's history, culture, art, festivals, geography, natural resources, economy, agriculture, industry, polity, and current affairs related to the state.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for UPSSSC Forensic Science Laboratory Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The online application and fee payment closing date is 17 August 2026. Fee reconciliation and application correction can be done until 24 August 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in UPSSSC Forensic Science Laboratory Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 208 total vacancies, comprising 134 Scientific Assistant (General Selection), 13 Scientific Assistant (Special Selection), 56 Lab Assistant (General Selection), and 5 Lab Assistant (Special Selection) posts.

faq.question: Q3. Who is eligible to apply for UPSSSC Forensic Science Laboratory Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Only candidates who appeared in the Preliminary Eligibility Test 2025 (PET-2025) and hold a valid, non-zero, non-negative normalized PET-2025 score, and who possess the required educational qualification for the relevant domain (Biology, Physical Science, Chemistry, or Computer Science), are eligible to apply.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for UPSSSC Forensic Science Laboratory Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must be between 21 and 40 years of age as on 1 July of the calendar year in which the vacancies are advertised, with relaxation applicable for reserved categories as per Uttar Pradesh government rules.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee for UPSSSC Forensic Science Laboratory Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The total application fee is Rs. 25.00 (online processing fee only) for all categories, including UR, OBC, SC, and ST candidates.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for Scientific Assistant and Lab Assistant posts?
faq.answer: Scientific Assistant posts carry Pay Level-6 (Rs. 35,400 – Rs. 1,12,400), while Lab Assistant posts carry Pay Level-4 (Rs. 25,500 – Rs. 81,100).

faq.question: Q7. What is the exam pattern for UPSSSC Forensic Science Laboratory Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The written examination has 100 objective-type MCQs worth 100 marks, to be completed in 2 hours, covering Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Mathematics, Forensic Science, Computer & IT concepts, and General Knowledge of Uttar Pradesh, with 25% negative marking per wrong answer.

faq.question: Q8. How is shortlisting done for the UPSSSC Forensic Science Laboratory Main Exam?
faq.answer: Shortlisting for the Main Examination is based on the normalized PET-2025 score, category-wise, at 15 times the number of advertised vacancies, including all candidates scoring at or above the applicable cut-off.

faq.question: Q9. How can I apply for UPSSSC Forensic Science Laboratory Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates must apply online only through upsssc.gov.in between 27 July 2026 and 17 August 2026 using their PET-2025 Registration Number for login.
